question: In which year did Armand Duplantis break the pole vault world record for the 12th time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The legendary pole vaulter **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis** broke the world record for the **12th** time in **February 2025**.
 
• He achieved this historic milestone at the **Mondo Classic**, an elite indoor meeting held in **Uppsala, Sweden**.
 
• During this event, **Duplantis** cleared a height of **6.27 metres**, surpassing his previous mark of **6.26 metres** set in **August 2024**.
